property.name: hive.server2.thrift.bind.host
property.description: Bind host on which to run the HiveServer2 Thrift interface. Can be overridden by setting $HIVE_SERVER2_THRIFT_BIND_HOST. (default: empty)

property.name: hive.metastore.uris
property.description: Hive connects to one of these URIs to make metadata requests to a remote Metastore (comma separated list of URIs, default: empty)

property.name: hive.compute.query.using.stats
property.description: When set to true Hive will answer a few queries like count(1) purely using stats stored in metastore. For basic stats collection turn on the config hive.stats.autogather to true. For more advanced stats collection need to run analyze table queries. (default: true)

property.name: javax.jdo.option.ConnectionURL
property.description: the URL of the MySQL database (for hivemetastore, default: jdbc:derby:;databaseName=metastore_db;create=true)

property.name: javax.jdo.option.ConnectionDriverName
property.description: Driver class name for a JDBC metastore. (default: org.apache.derby.jdbc.EmbeddedDriver)

property.name: javax.jdo.option.ConnectionUserName
property.description: Username to use against metastore database. (default: APP)

property.name: javax.jdo.option.ConnectionPassword
property.description: password to use against metastore database. (default: mine)

property.name: hive.metastore.schema.verification
property.description: Enforce metastore schema version consistency. (default: true) True: Verify that version information stored in metastore matches with one from Hive jars. Also disable automatic schema migration attempt (see datanucleus.autoCreateSchema and datanucleus.schema.autoCreateAll ). Users are required to manually migrate schema after Hive upgrade which ensures proper metastore schema migration. False: Warn if the version information stored in metastore doesn't match with one from Hive jars.

property.name: hive.support.concurrency
property.description: Enable Hive's Table Lock Manager Service (default: false)

property.name: hive.enforce.bucketing
property.description: Whether bucketing is enforced. If true, while inserting into the table, bucketing is enforced. Hive 2.x+ need not. (default: false)

property.name: hive.exec.dynamic.partition.mode
property.description: Set to nonstrict to support INSERT ... VALUES, UPDATE, and DELETE transactions (Hive 0.14.0 and later). For a complete list of parameters required for turning on Hive transactions. (default: strict)

property.name: hive.txn.manager
property.description: Set this to org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.lockmgr.DbTxnManager as part of turning on Hive transactions. (default: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.lockmgr.DummyTxnManager)

property.name: hive.zookeeper.quorum
property.description: List of ZooKeeper servers to talk to. This is needed for (default: empty): 1. Read/write locks - when hive.lock.manager is set to org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.lockmgr.zookeeper.ZooKeeperHiveLockManager, 2. When HiveServer2 supports service discovery via Zookeeper. 3. For delegation token storage if zookeeper store is used, if hive.cluster.delegation.token.store.zookeeper.connectString is not set 4. LLAP daemon registry service 5. Leader selection for privilege synchronizer

property.name: hive.compactor.initiator.on
property.description: Whether to run the initiator thread on this metastore instance. Set this to true on one instance of the Thrift metastore service as part of turning on Hive transactions. (default: false)

property.name: hive.compactor.worker.threads
property.description: How many compactor worker threads to run on this metastore instance. Set this to a positive number on one or more instances of the Thrift metastore service as part of turning on Hive transactions. (default: 0)

property.name: hive.tez.container.size
property.description: By default Tez will spawn containers of the size of a mapper. This can be used to overwrite the default. (default: -1)

property.name: hive.tez.java.opts
property.description: By default Tez will use the Java options from map tasks. This can be used to overwrite the default. (default: empty)

property.name: hive.convert.join.bucket.mapjoin.tez
property.description: Whether joins can be automatically converted to bucket map joins in hive when tez is used as the execution engine.

property.name: hive.llap.zk.registry.user
property.description: In the LLAP ZooKeeper-based registry, specifies the username in the Zookeeper path. This should be the hive user or whichever user is running the LLAP daemon.

property.name: hive.llap.daemon.service.hosts
property.description: Explicitly specified hosts to use for LLAP scheduling. Useful for testing. By default, YARN registry is used.

property.name: hive.llap.daemon.memory.per.instance.mb
property.description: The total amount of memory to use for the executors inside LLAP (in megabytes). (default: 4096)

property.name: hive.llap.daemon.num.executors
property.description: Number of executors to use in LLAP daemon; essentially, the number of tasks that can be executed in parallel. (default: 4)
